description: This PHP source file defines the BlockPluginId class, a Drupal migration process plugin responsible for determining block plugin IDs during migration. It includes methods for constructing the plugin, creating instances via dependency injection, and transforming input values into appropriate block identifiers, with deprecation notices indicating it is obsolete in Drupal 11.3 and removed in Drupal 12.
